evidence.quote: an English-taught Bachelor's programme in digital communication
Costs per semester: Non EU/EEA students**
Entrance exam (Round 1): Online application form deadline: 20 May 2026 (via application portal)
Entrance exam (Round 2): Online application form deadline: 30 June 2026 (via application portal)

notes: Tuition: the EUR 1,500 per semester fee is stated for non-EU/EEA students on the programme's own admission page ('Costs per semester: Non EU/EEA students**' with 'Tuition Fees: 1,500.00*'); DAAD also lists 'non-EU countries 1,500 EUR' per semester, while the central costs page says '€ 1500 per semester'. However, the admission page adds that non-EU/EEA students with a German school leaving certificate are exempt, and exemption criteria may apply, so the amount should be confirmed. Intakes: the entrance-exam application-form deadlines of 20 May 2026 (Round 1) and 30 June 2026 (Round 2) are given; non-EU/EEA applicants without a German entrance qualification must use Round 1 (20 May 2026). 'All application documents deadline: 22 June 2026' and '15 July 2026' are also stated. Application channel: the pages state that non-EU/EEA applicants upload documents via the HdM admission portal (direct), but they do not mention uni-assist or a VPD; the required recognition of foreign certificates is done by Studienkolleg Konstanz, not uni-assist. The entry is intended for the winter semester ('Beginning Winter semester'), but no exact start date is given.

note.fr: Un examen d'entrée obligatoire (formulaire de candidature, test d'anglais et entretien en ligne) doit être réussi avant de pouvoir déposer une candidature ; il compte pour 70 % du classement, le diplôme de fin d'études secondaires pour 30 %.
note.en: A mandatory entrance exam (application form, English proficiency test and online interview) must be passed before you may apply; it accounts for 70% of the ranking and the school leaving certificate for 30%.

evidence.quote: To be eligible to apply for a study place in the Social Media Marketing & Management programme, applicants must first successfully complete a mandatory entrance exam.
Admission is based on a ranking, with the entrance exam accounting for 70% and the school leaving certificate for 30%.

note.fr: Les candidats internationaux sans diplôme allemand d'accès à l'enseignement supérieur doivent faire reconnaître leur certificat par le Studienkolleg Konstanz (certificat de reconnaissance à soumettre avant le 15 juillet).
note.en: International applicants without a German higher education entrance qualification must have their certificate recognised by the Studienkolleg Konstanz (certificate of recognition to be submitted by 15 July).

evidence.quote: In order to be admitted to HdM, international applicants with an international degree need a recognition of certificates from the Studienkolleg Konstanz.
The certificate of recognition must be submitted by the end of the application period (15 July).

note.fr: Les candidats internationaux sans diplôme allemand doivent passer l'examen d'entrée du tour 1 (Round 1).
note.en: International applicants without a German higher education entrance qualification must apply for entrance exam (Round 1).

evidence.quote: International applicants from non-EU/EEA countries without a German higher education entrance qualification must apply for entrance exam (Round 1).

note.fr: Prévoir un visa et une preuve de fonds (compte bloqué) pour étudier en Allemagne.
note.en: You will need a visa and proof of sufficient funds (blocked account) to study in Germany.
